auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.account_id)
FROM account AS T2
INNER JOIN AccountLoan AS T1 ON T2.account_id = T1.account_id
INNER JOIN LoanDetails AS T3 ON T1.loan_id = T3.loan_id
WHERE T3.amount < 100000

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT 
    (CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.status = 'A' THEN T2.account_id END) AS REAL) * 100) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT T2.account_id), 0) 
FROM 
    LoanDetails AS T1 
JOIN 
    AccountLoan AS T2 
ON 
    T1.loan_id = T2.loan_id 
WHERE 
    T1.amount < 100000
